name: Department of Commerce
summary: The Government of India department responsible for formulating and implementing foreign trade policy and for multilateral and bilateral commercial relations.

name: Directorate General of Foreign Trade
parentBody: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: The authority that implements India's Foreign Trade Policy. It issues the Importer-Exporter Code (IEC), administers export and import authorisations and schemes, and notifies the ITC (HS) import and export policy for goods.
functions: Export and import authorisations and licences

name: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
parentBody: Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance
summary: The national board that administers customs law and central indirect taxes in India, including the levy and collection of customs duties and the regulation of import and export clearance.

verification.note: Official website did not respond to an automated check on 2026-11-17.

name: Indian Customs Electronic Gateway
parentBody: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
summary: The national e-commerce portal of Indian Customs, used by traders, customs brokers and carriers for electronic filing of customs documents such as the Bill of Entry and the Shipping Bill, and for e-payment of duty.
functions: Electronic filing of Bill of Entry and Shipping Bill

name: Goods and Services Tax common portal
summary: The common portal for Goods and Services Tax registration, returns and refunds in India. GST registration and returns are relevant to exporters and importers, including IGST on imports and export refunds.

name: Reserve Bank of India
summary: India's central bank. Under the Foreign Exchange Management Act it regulates foreign-exchange transactions, including the realisation and repatriation of export proceeds and payments for imports, through authorised dealer banks.

name: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority
summary: A statutory authority that promotes and develops exports of scheduled agricultural and processed food products, and registers exporters of those products.
functions: Registration of exporters of scheduled products
Export promotion for agricultural and processed foods
Standards and traceability systems for scheduled products

name: Marine Products Export Development Authority
summary: A statutory authority responsible for the development and promotion of India's marine product exports, including registration of exporters and processing facilities in the sector.

name: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
parentBody: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: The statutory food regulator of India. It sets food standards and regulates the manufacture, storage, distribution, sale and import of food, including clearance of imported food consignments.

relations.note: Codex Alimentarius standards are an international reference for food regulation.

name: Bureau of Indian Standards
parentBody: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
summary: The national standards body of India. It formulates Indian Standards and operates product certification schemes; some products require BIS certification before they can be imported or sold in India.
functions: Product certification and compulsory registration schemes

relations.note: BIS is India's national standards body in ISO.

name: Export Inspection Council of India
summary: India's official export certification body, set up to ensure the quality of exports through quality control and pre-shipment inspection of notified commodities, operating through Export Inspection Agencies.
functions: Pre-shipment inspection and certification of notified commodities
Health certificates for certain food exports
Certificates of origin under certain preferential schemes

name: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine and Storage
parentBody: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: India's national plant protection organization. It operates plant quarantine stations, issues phytosanitary certificates for exports of plants and plant products, and regulates their import.
functions: Plant quarantine import permits and inspection

relations.note: National plant protection organizations implement IPPC standards (ISPMs).

name: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation
parentBody: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: India's national regulatory authority for drugs, medical devices and cosmetics. It regulates the import of these products and issues related registrations, licences and export certificates.
functions: Import registration and licensing for drugs, medical devices and cosmetics
Export no-objection certificates for regulated products
Approval of new drugs and clinical trials

name: Directorate General of Shipping
parentBody: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
summary: India's maritime administration. It implements merchant shipping law, including ship registration, maritime safety, seafarer certification and the implementation of international maritime conventions.

verification.note: Official website did not respond to an automated check on 2026-11-17.

name: ECGC Limited
summary: A Government of India enterprise that provides export credit insurance to exporters against the risk of non-payment by overseas buyers, and credit-risk cover to banks that finance exports.
functions: Export credit insurance policies for exporters

name: Indian Trade Portal
parentBody: Department of Commerce (maintained by the Federation of Indian Export Organisations)
summary: A Department of Commerce trade information portal that publishes tariff, rules-of-origin and market-access information for Indian exporters and importers.
